The cover features a dynamic illustration of a superhero character in a red and black suit running across the top left. The background includes stylized clouds and sky. The bottom portion shows a stack of other comic books or pages with colorful spines/edges. The image has a glossy, printed texture typical of comic book paper.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title text is mirrored/reversed ('OWO CIFIRRET' roughly). While stylistic mirroring exists, AI often fails to render coherent text, and this looks like a generation artifact rather than intentional design, especially given the slight warping of letter shapes.
The geometric structure of the stacked items at the bottom is inconsistent. The lines do not converge logically, and some edges seem to melt into each other or float without proper physical support.
The feet blend slightly into the background/surface they are running on, lacking clear contact shadows or distinct boundary separation.
